items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: she was a very good friend of my mother... they were friends

ctx.x: Why was he named by a Greek lady?

Well, she was a very good friend of my mother. They were, for years they were friends. She'd come to my house and sit on the step with my mother, and she would -- they would talk, and she'd bring a basket. Always I can see it was a little basket now on her arm, and she'd have some goodies in there. Each time she came -- some kind of cake, candies or something she had made and she wanted my mother to taste it, and every so often my mother would pick out a day she would go to her house and take me along, you know,…
